source: HM Revenue and Customs, Payrolled employments in the UK by nationality, region and industrial sector, from July 2014 to December 2025, published 14 April 2026 (regional tables: monthly counts of payrolled employments by industry SIC codes (A-U) for UK, EU and non-EU nationals). This file holds the latest month and the change from the same month five years earlier, per region and industry.
caveat: Counts are employments, not employees (a person with two jobs is counted twice), rounded to the nearest 100, so breakdowns may not sum to totals. Region is where the employee lives, not where they work. Industry is the SIC 2007 section (A to U). Cells HMRC marks [c] (confidential) appear as missing.
